desc: Coordinate-compress nums and initialize left/right frequency arrays, side lengths, and running sums of squared frequencies.
Sweep each possible middle index, moving nums[i] from the right side to the left side and computing x frequencies and pair counts for 0/1/2 copies of x on both sides.
Count all choices with k >= 2 using pair-category products.
Implement the distinct-value pair formula excluding x and a given y using side length, sum of squared frequencies, and frequency of y.
Add valid k = 1 choices by looping over y != x for both left-supplies-x and right-supplies-x cases.
Accumulate the answer modulo 10^9 + 7 and verify against the provided examples.
